info.title: Meteora DLMM swap indexer API
info.description: Read-only REST API over indexed Meteora DLMM swaps, except `POST /v1/backfills` and `DELETE /v1/backfills/{job_id}`, which request and cancel history fills. Times are UTC RFC 3339, and token amounts are strings in raw base units and in human units so that no precision is lost.

get.description: Reads the indexed tip, the job counts and the projections being rebuilt, and derives `status`.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.description: Offset pages over every indexed pool, ordered by `volume_usd_24h` descending (a pool without priced volume counts as 0), then `swap_count_24h` descending, then address. The ranking moves as blocks land, so a pool can cross a page boundary between two requests. An offset past the end gives an empty page with the same `page.total`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Canonical decimal only: no sign, no leading zero, no spaces.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of ranked pools to skip. Canonical decimal only.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_query`: The query string cannot be parsed. `invalid_limit`: `limit` is not a canonical decimal integer from 1 to 100. `invalid_offset`: `offset` is not a canonical non-negative decimal integer.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `projection_rebuilding`: The pool ranking reads `pool_stats` and `pool_volume_1h`; either one mid-rebuild gives 503. `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.description: The same object as an entry of `GET /v1/pools`.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_pool`: The `pool` path segment is not a base58 32-byte address.

404.description: Not found. Codes: `pool_not_found`: The pool is well formed but the indexer has never seen it.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `projection_rebuilding`: The summary reads `pool_stats` and `pool_volume_1h`; either one mid-rebuild gives 503. An unknown pool is still 404. `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.summary: Hourly or daily volume of one pool.
get.description: The API floors `from` and ceils `to` to UTC bucket boundaries (top of the hour, or UTC midnight) and echoes the aligned window. Every bucket in the window is present, oldest first; a bucket without swaps has zero volumes and a null `volume_usd`. At most 744 hourly or 366 daily buckets per request. Validation order: pool, existence, bucket, from, to, alignment, cap.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start instant, RFC 3339 with any offset (encode `+` as `%2B`). Floored to the bucket.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End instant, RFC 3339 with any offset. Ceiled to the bucket; the aligned end is exclusive.

200.description: The pool's buckets over the aligned window.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_pool`: The `pool` path segment is not a base58 32-byte address. `invalid_query`: The query string cannot be parsed. `invalid_bucket`: `bucket` is missing or is not `hour` or `day`. `invalid_time`: `from` or `to` is missing or is not an RFC 3339 timestamp. The message names the parameter. `invalid_range`: `from` is not before `to` after alignment to the bucket. `range_too_large`: The aligned range holds more than 744 hourly or 366 daily buckets. The message gives the count and the cap.

404.description: Not found. Codes: `pool_not_found`: The pool is well formed but the indexer has never seen it.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `projection_rebuilding`: `bucket=hour` reads `pool_volume_1h` and `bucket=day` reads `pool_volume_1d`; only the table of the requested bucket gives 503. `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.description: Keyset pages, newest first by block time and log position. Swaps that land while a client pages never shift or repeat a page. Served from the swap log, so a projection rebuild never gives 503 here.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Canonical decimal only: no sign, no leading zero, no spaces.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the `page.next_cursor` of the previous page. Omit it for the newest page. Clients must not build or edit it.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_pool`: The `pool` path segment is not a base58 32-byte address. `invalid_query`: The query string cannot be parsed. `invalid_limit`: `limit` is not a canonical decimal integer from 1 to 100. `invalid_cursor`: `before` is not a `next_cursor` that this API issued.

404.description: Not found. Codes: `pool_not_found`: The pool is well formed but the indexer has never seen it.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

post.summary: Request a backfill of history from an instant.
post.description: Resolves `from` to the first slot at or after it over RPC (tens of RPC calls; allow 120 s), then inserts one job from that slot up to the slot below the oldest indexed slot. The body is read as JSON whatever the `Content-Type`. The indexer splits a job older than one week at the week line; the returned `job_id` stays on the newest piece.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_backfill_body`: The body is not JSON with a `from` string that is an RFC 3339 timestamp. `backfill_from_in_future`: `from` is later than now. A backfill fills history only. `backfill_from_after_coverage`: `from` resolves to a slot at or above the oldest indexed slot, so there is nothing to fill.

409.description: Conflict. Codes: `nothing_indexed_yet`: No block is indexed yet, so there is no indexed range for a backfill to end below. `backfill_overlaps_job`: Another job already owns part of the requested range. Do not resubmit.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

502.description: Bad gateway. Codes: `rpc_unavailable`: The RPC endpoint failed while the API resolved `from` to a slot. Retry later.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `backfill_unavailable`: The API was started without `RPC_URL`, so it cannot resolve `from` to a slot. `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.description: Every fill job, whether a backfill request or a hole that the reconciler opened, newest first by creation time, at most 50.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_job_id`: The `job_id` path segment is not a positive integer.

404.description: Not found. Codes: `job_not_found`: No job has that id.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

delete.description: Blocks the job with reason `cancelled` instead of deleting it, so the reconciler does not reopen its range. From then on, health reports `blocked`. Only an operator can resume it.

400.description: Bad request. Codes: `invalid_job_id`: The `job_id` path segment is not a positive integer.

404.description: Not found. Codes: `job_not_found`: No job has that id.

409.description: Conflict. Codes: `job_already_completed`: The job is completed, so there is nothing to cancel. `job_already_blocked`: The job is already blocked (cancelled jobs included). The message names the existing reason.

500.description: Internal error. Codes: `internal`: An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

503.description: Service unavailable. Codes: `database_unavailable`: The database did not answer. Retry later.

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 document that the binary embeds, as `application/json`.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx response with a body.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Not stable; match on `code`.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code. `invalid_pool` (400): The `pool` path segment is not a base58 32-byte address. `pool_not_found` (404): The pool is well formed but the indexer has never seen it. `invalid_query` (400): The query string cannot be parsed. `invalid_bucket` (400): `bucket` is missing or is not `hour` or `day`. `invalid_time` (400): `from` or `to` is missing or is not an RFC 3339 timestamp. The message names the parameter. `invalid_range` (400): `from` is not before `to` after alignment to the bucket. `range_too_large` (400): The aligned range holds more than 744 hourly or 366 daily buckets. The message gives the count and the cap. `invalid_limit` (400): `limit` is not a canonical decimal integer from 1 to 100. `invalid_offset` (400): `offset` is not a canonical non-negative decimal integer. `invalid_cursor` (400): `before` is not a `next_cursor` that this API issued. `not_found` (404): No route matches the path. `database_unavailable` (503): The database did not answer. Retry later. `projection_rebuilding` (503): A projection table that the request reads from is being rebuilt offline and holds only part of the log. The message names the table. Retry after the rebuild; `GET /v1/health` lists the tables in `rebuilding`. `invalid_backfill_body` (400): The body is not JSON with a `from` string that is an RFC 3339 timestamp. `backfill_from_in_future` (400): `from` is later than now. A backfill fills history only. `backfill_from_after_coverage` (400): `from` resolves to a slot at or above the oldest indexed slot, so there is nothing to fill. `nothing_indexed_yet` (409): No block is indexed yet, so there is no indexed range for a backfill to end below. `backfill_overlaps_job` (409): Another job already owns part of the requested range. Do not resubmit. `invalid_job_id` (400): The `job_id` path segment is not a positive integer. `job_not_found` (404): No job has that id. `job_already_completed` (409): The job is completed, so there is nothing to cancel. `job_already_blocked` (409): The job is already blocked (cancelled jobs included). The message names the existing reason. `backfill_unavailable` (503): The API was started without `RPC_URL`, so it cannot resolve `from` to a slot. `rpc_unavailable` (502): The RPC endpoint failed while the API resolved `from` to a slot. Retry later. `internal` (500): An unexpected server fault. The server log has the cause.

HealthStatus.description: Derived indexer status; the first match in this order wins. `starting`: The indexer has not committed a block yet (`cursor_slot` is null). `lagging`: `lag_seconds` is more than 120: the newest indexed block is old. `blocked`: `blocked_job_count` is more than 0: a fill job waits on an operator. Cancelled backfills count here. `backfilling`: `open_job_count` is more than 0: holes in coverage are still being filled, so recent buckets can be incomplete. `ok`: No other status applies.

cursor_slot.description: Highest indexed slot: the end of the top coverage range. Null until the first block commits.

last_block_time.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Block time at `cursor_slot`. Null until the first block commits.

lag_seconds.description: Seconds from `last_block_time` to now, never negative. Null when `last_block_time` is null.

open_job_count.description: Fill jobs still to walk: not completed, not blocked.

blocked_job_count.description: Jobs that wait on an operator: not completed, with a blocked reason (cancelled jobs included).

rebuilding.description: Projection tables that an offline rebuild holds, in name order. Routes that read them answer 503 `projection_rebuilding`. Omitted when no table is rebuilding.

Pool.description: One pool's summary. The 24-hour window is the current UTC hour and the 23 hours before it.

mint_x.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of the pool's token X.

mint_y.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of the pool's token Y.

decimals_x.description: Decimals of token X. Null until the indexer fetched the mint.

decimals_y.description: Decimals of token Y. Null until the indexer fetched the mint.

volume_usd_24h.description: Exact decimal string, no exponent, trailing zeros removed. USD volume of the priced swaps in the 24-hour window. Null when the window holds no priced swap (no swaps, or every swap unpriced).

first_swap_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Block time of the pool's first indexed swap. Null before the first swap.

last_swap_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Block time of the pool's last indexed swap. Null before the first swap.

total.description: Every indexed pool, read in the same statement as the page.

pools.description: Pools in rank order. Empty past the end.

start.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Bucket start: top of the hour or UTC midnight.

volume_x.description: Exact decimal string, no exponent, trailing zeros removed. Token X volume in human units (raw divided by 10^decimals_x). Null when `decimals_x` is unknown.

volume_x_raw.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Token X volume. A string because sums exceed 64 bits.

volume_y.description: Exact decimal string, no exponent, trailing zeros removed. Token Y volume in human units. Null when `decimals_y` is unknown.

volume_y_raw.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Token Y volume.

volume_usd.description: Exact decimal string, no exponent, trailing zeros removed. USD volume of the bucket's priced swaps. Null when the bucket is empty or every swap in it is unpriced. When `unpriced_swap_count` > 0 it is a lower bound.

unpriced_swap_count.description: Swaps in the bucket without a USD value. Never more than `swap_count`.

Volume.description: A pool's buckets over the aligned window.

mint_x.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of token X.

mint_y.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of token Y.

decimals_x.description: Decimals of token X. Null until fetched.

decimals_y.description: Decimals of token Y. Null until fetched.

first_swap_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Block time of the pool's first indexed swap. Buckets before it read zero because nothing was indexed, not because nothing traded. Null before the first swap and while `pool_stats` rebuilds.

from.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Aligned window start, inclusive.

to.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Aligned window end, exclusive.

buckets.description: Every bucket from `from` to `to`, oldest first, with none missing.

swap_ordinal.description: Position of this swap among the DLMM swaps of its transaction, from 0. With `signature` it identifies the swap.

block_time.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. Block time.

user.description: Base58 32-byte address. The swap event's `from`: the account that swapped. A router's account when the swap was routed.

mint_in.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of the input token.

mint_out.description: Base58 32-byte address. Mint of the output token.

amount_in.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Input amount.

amount_out.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Output amount.

fee.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Total fee.

protocol_fee.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Protocol share of `fee`.

host_fee.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Host (referrer) share of `fee`.

fee_rate_1e9.description: Fee rate scaled by 1e9 (100000000 is 10%). Integer string.

mm_fee.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Market-maker share of `fee`, from the `Swap2Evt` event. Null when the swap has no decoded `Swap2Evt`.

limit_order_fee.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). Limit-order share of `fee`, from `Swap2Evt`. Null without `Swap2Evt`.

amount_left.description: Integer string in the token's raw base units (not scaled by decimals). `Swap2Evt.amount_left`. Null without `Swap2Evt`.

fee_side.description: Whether the fee was charged on the input or the output token, from `Swap2Evt`. Null without `Swap2Evt`.

fee_token.description: Pool token the fee is denominated in, from `Swap2Evt`. Null without `Swap2Evt`.

quote_asset.description: The leg that priced the swap. Null when neither mint is SOL, USDC or USDT.

volume_usd.description: Exact decimal string, no exponent, trailing zeros removed. USD value of the swap from its quote leg. Null when the swap is unpriced.

source.description: Path that indexed the swap: the Geyser stream, the RPC tail, or a fill job.

fill_job_id.description: Id of the fill job that indexed the swap. Null unless `source` is `fill`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; send it as `before` for the next older page. Null on the last page.

SwapList.description: One page of a pool's swaps.

BackfillRequest.description: Backfill request. Unknown keys are ignored.

from.description: RFC 3339 instant with any offset, not in the future. The job starts at the first slot at or after it.

start_slot.description: First slot at or after `from`, inclusive.

end_slot.description: The slot below the oldest indexed slot, inclusive.

BackfillJobState.description: Derived job state. `completed`: the reconciler found the whole range covered. `cancelled`: blocked with reason `cancelled`. `blocked`: blocked with another reason; an operator must act. `open`: none of these.

start_slot.description: First slot of the job's range, inclusive.

end_slot.description: Last slot of the job's range, inclusive.

next_slot.description: The next slot the filler walks. Above `end_slot` once the walk is done; the job is `completed` only after the reconciler finds its whole range covered.

end_kind.description: How `end_slot` was set. `block`: a known block (a hole's end, the archive window's top, or an unmappable slot). `archive_lower_cut`: the slot below the archive's bottom when the reconciler cut the job; it may be a skipped slot.

blocked_reason.description: Why the job is blocked: `cancelled`, or a reason the filler wrote (for example `missing_in_storage:<slot>`). Null when not blocked.

completed_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. When the reconciler marked the job completed. Null until then.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, `Z` suffix. When the job was inserted.

jobs.description: At most 50 jobs, newest first by `created_at`.

start_slot.description: First slot of the job's range, inclusive.

end_slot.description: Last slot of the job's range, inclusive.

next_slot.description: Where the walk stopped: slots from here to `end_slot` stay unfilled.
